cards.title: 题型

body.p: Write an Email 要求根据一个学术或社交情境写一封邮件。题目给出收件人和 3 条要求。每条要求都要用句子完成，只提到相关的词不算完成。

body.box: Write to the costume supervisor. Explain why a coat needs repair, suggest a repair, and ask when it can be collected.

body.p: 这道题要求说明损坏原因、提出修补办法、询问领取时间。The coat has a loose button 只描述问题，不能替代后两项。
邮件任务共 7 分钟，包括阅读和作答。界面提供字数统计，不提供拼写检查。评分看四个方面：任务完成、细节展开、语域和语言准确性。本课的小测用选择题检查这些方面。

cards.src: overview 第 14 页；lessonplan 第 7 页

cards.title: 解题步骤
cards.note: 以上为本课程的建议，不是官方规定。

steps.d: 用约 1 分钟读情境，把每条要求变成一个动作。例题中的 explain、suggest、ask 分别对应原因、办法和询问。收件人是 costume supervisor。
用约 5 分钟写正文，每条要求至少写一句有内容的话。I could replace the button before rehearsal 提出了办法，I need help 没有。
用约 1 分钟逐条核对要求，再检查句子和语气。When could I collect the repaired coat? 明确问了时间。Thank you 不能代替这个问句。

cards.title: 要求与完成证据
rows: 说明原因
The seam opened because the coat was too tight.
原因要解释眼前的问题，只说有困难不够。
描述经过
The fastening broke during yesterday's rehearsal.
写出发生了什么或结果，不只写评价。
提出建议
We could replace the fastening with a stronger one.
建议要给出具体的办法。
询问信息
Could you tell me when the coat will be ready?
询问要写明想知道的信息。
发出邀请
Would you join our costume review on Friday?
要直接请收件人参加，只介绍活动不够。
表示感谢
Thank you for repairing the torn pocket.
感谢对方做的具体的事。感谢不能代替其他要求。

cards.title: 评分标准
rows: 展开有效，表达清楚，语域一致，语言准确且有变化。
The clasp broke, so I suggest replacing it before the next rehearsal. 这一句展开有效。档次看整篇表现。
展开充分，容易理解，语域大体合适，仅有少量错误。
The clasps was loose, but replacing them solved the problem. 有一处主谓一致错误，不影响理解。
基本完成任务，部分展开不足，较明显的错误影响局部表达。
The coat need repair. Please change something. 有需求，但修什么不清楚。
尝试回应任务，展开有限或无关，累积错误使信息难懂。
Coat problem yesterday. I want repair it because button no work. 句子之间的关系要读者去猜。
几乎没有展开，短语零散，严重错误或大量借用题目。
Coat. Broken. Please. 只有与任务有关的零散词语。
空白、拒答、非英语、完全抄题、完全无关或乱敲字符。
Write to the costume supervisor. 全文只抄了这一句题目，属于完全抄题。
cards.note: 每个例句只说明一种特征，分数按整篇定。评分依据为 rubric 第 1 页。

body.box:
Task: Write to the university archive officer. Describe an unreadable label on a donated map, explain why an accurate label matters, and ask for a way to verify it.

Dear Archive Officer,
The label on the map donated by my family has faded, and the town name is no longer clear. We are preparing a list of the donated items. Could you compare the map with the original donation record?
Best regards,
Rui

Which requirement is only partly developed?
1. Describe the condition of the label.
2. Explain the importance of identifying the place.
3. Request a method of checking the label.
4. Identify the record that could be consulted.

body.p: 第一句写明 town name is no longer clear，末句请对方 compare the map with the original donation record。We are preparing a list 只交代了背景，没有说明准确的地名对清单有什么用，所以答案是第二项。
可以补一句 Without the town name, visitors may confuse this map with another item on the list。这一句说明了地名和辨认清单上的物品有什么关系。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 把背景当要求
把 preparing a list 当作必须另写的第四项。
只按题目列出的动作核对。
把提及当完成
出现 label 就认定已解释标签的重要性。
查找说明重要性的理由或后果。
把单处错误当档次
见 The labels was faded 就认定整篇为 2 分。
看错误是否多到妨碍理解。
把长度当展开
反复写 The map matters 而没有说明用途。
只计与要求有关的新信息。
把礼貌当完整
以 Thank you 代替核实方法的请求。
感谢和请求是两种功能，分开核对。

groups.text:
Task: Write to the sports-equipment officer. Describe a torn badminton net, suggest a replacement, and ask where the damaged net should be returned.
Draft: Dear Equipment Officer, A large hole appeared in the net during practice. The spare net in Cabinet 2 seems suitable. Could you tell me when the spare can be collected? Best regards, Lan

options: Asking for the return location of the damaged net
Describing what happened to the current net
Proposing an alternative net for practice
Asking when to collect the replacement
items.why: 题目要求 ask where the damaged net should be returned，正文问的却是 when the spare can be collected，即第一项。第四项是正文已经问了的内容。

groups.text:
Task: Write to the student orchestra treasurer about a duplicate payment. Describe the payment, request a refund, and explain how to contact the payer.
Draft: Dear Treasurer, I paid the instrument deposit twice on Monday. Please return the second payment to the original account. My email address is listed on the receipt. Best regards, Min

options: The person who paid the deposit
The person who manages the orchestra's funds
The person who stores the instrument
The person who issued the email account
items.why: Write to the student orchestra treasurer 指的是管理乐团资金的人，即第二项。payer 是写信人，不是收件人。

groups.text:
Task: Describe a damaged display case and request a repair.
Draft: Dear Exhibitions Team, Case 6 has a broken lock. The glass is intact, but the door cannot be secured. Could you arrange a replacement lock before the objects arrive? Best regards, Jun

items.stem: Which feature supports effective task completion?
options: The draft proposes replacing the glass and the lock.
The draft describes the objects inside the locked case.
The draft connects a specific defect with a specific request.
The draft explains why the objects arrived before the repair.
items.why: The glass is intact 和 the door cannot be secured 指出坏的是锁，replacement lock 正对着这个故障，即第三项。

groups.text:
Task: Explain why a name is missing from a certificate and request a corrected copy.
Draft: Certificate name missing. My name where. Copy good please.

items.stem: Which weakness is evident in this draft?
options: A detailed explanation includes an unnecessary example.
A clear request contains one minor spelling error.
A complete explanation uses an overly formal closing.
Disconnected fragments leave the intended message unclear.
items.why: Certificate name missing 和 My name where 是零散的短语，意思不清楚，即第四项。这接近 1 分档描述的语言。

groups.text:
Task: Write to the manager of a campus parcel desk. Describe a parcel sent to the wrong desk, explain why it is needed soon, and request a transfer.

Dear Parcel Manager,
My parcel was sent to the North Desk rather than the South Desk. It contains the fabric samples for our design review tomorrow. I cannot travel to the North Desk today. The parcel is important to our group, and we would appreciate help.
Best regards,
Elena

items.stem: Which action still needs an explicit sentence?
options: Describing the parcel's contents
Identifying the two parcel desks
Requesting that the parcel be moved
Explaining the need for prompt access
items.why: 正文有 North Desk rather than the South Desk 和 design review tomorrow，但 we would appreciate help 没有明确提出 transfer，即第三项。

items.stem: Which revision best addresses the main weakness?
options: Could the parcel be transferred to the South Desk today?
The samples are important because they are important to us.
The North Desk is where the parcel is currently located.
Thank you for reading about tomorrow's design review.
items.why: 题目要求 request a transfer，第一项写明了移什么、移到哪里、什么时候移。

groups.text:
Task: Write to the campus observatory coordinator. Describe an access-card problem, explain its effect on a scheduled observation, and ask for temporary access.

Dear Observatory Coordinator,
My access card stopped working this afternoon. The entrance reader showed a red light each time I tried it. Our group is scheduled to observe tonight, so we cannot reach the telescope without help. Thank you for considering this problem.
Best regards,
Sonia

items.stem: Which requirement has not been completed?
options: Asking for an interim way to enter
Explaining how the reader responded
Identifying the activity affected by the problem
Stating when the card stopped working
items.why: 正文写了 reader showed a red light 和 cannot reach the telescope，但 Thank you for considering this problem 没有请求 temporary access，即第一项。

options: The group member who plans the observation
The person who coordinates observatory access
The person who manufactured the card reader
The student who previously used the telescope
items.why: 题目 Write to the campus observatory coordinator 写明了收件人，即第二项。第一项的 group 虽然在正文出现，但不是收件人。

items.stem: Which revision most directly improves task completion?
options: The entrance reader displayed a red light this afternoon.
Our group has an observation scheduled for this evening.
Could you arrange temporary entry for our group tonight?
Thank you for considering the difficulty with our access card.
items.why: ask for temporary access 要求请求临时进入，第三项提出了这个请求。另外三项只是重复正文已有的信息。

items.stem: Which statement best describes the draft's main limitation?
options: The observation is described without any access problem.
The reader's response is unrelated to the card's failure.
The message is too fragmented to identify the affected activity.
The problem is clear, but the requested action remains unstated.
items.why: My access card stopped working 说明了问题，scheduled to observe tonight 说明了影响，但没有一句请求临时进入，即第四项。

groups.text:
Task: Write to the ceramics studio supervisor. Explain why a finished bowl was mislabeled, request a corrected label, and state when it will be collected.

Dear Studio Supervisor,
The bowl from Shelf 4 has the name of another student. Two labels were exchanged when our pieces were packed. Please replace the name label with one bearing my name, Nora Chen. I will collect the bowl after Monday's class. The bowl is very important. It is important because this bowl matters to me.
Best regards,
Nora Chen

items.stem: Which phrase in the task requires a cause rather than an action or a date?
options: Request a corrected label
State when it will be collected
Explain why a finished bowl was mislabeled
Write to the ceramics studio supervisor
items.why: Explain why 要求写原因，即第三项。正文的 Two labels were exchanged 完成了这一项。

items.stem: Which requirement is completed by the sentence about Monday?
options: Naming the student who exchanged the labels
Giving the planned collection time
Requesting the supervisor's name on the label
Explaining why the bowl needs a label
items.why: I will collect the bowl after Monday's class 对应 state when it will be collected，即第二项。

items.stem: Which change would make the development more effective?
options: Remove the repeated claims that the bowl is important.
Remove the account of how the labels were exchanged.
Replace the collection date with another statement of importance.
Replace the requested correction with thanks for the label.
items.why: The bowl is very important 和 It is important because this bowl matters to me 重复同一个评价，没有新信息，应删去，即第一项。

items.stem: Which observation supports the draft's communicative effectiveness?
options: The repeated claims explain why the labels were exchanged.
The collection date proves the correction has already been made.
The shelf number explains who packed the pieces incorrectly.
The requested correction identifies the exact name to print.
items.why: one bearing my name, Nora Chen 写明了标签上要印的名字，即第四项。第二项把 I will collect 这个计划当成了修改已完成。
